comparisons.interpretation: Bush explicitly presents direct action as part of congressional work, citing the eviction moratorium. Roberts says the legislator's work should happen inside the Capitol rather than on the streets, while acknowledging shared issue concerns. This is a source-backed difference in political strategy, not proof that their entire platforms are opposites.
